test_title: PYST 34: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

My brother was being laughed at by them.

options.text: They have been laughing at my brother.
They were laughing at my brother.
They had been laughing at my brother.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **They were laughing at my brother.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** We need to change it into **active voice.**
 
• The subject **'my brother' **becomes the object of the active voice and the objec**t 'them' **becomes the subject **'they'** of the active voice.
 
• **'was being laughed' **changes to **'were laughing'.**
 
• Structure of **Past Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject.
 
• Active Voice: Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

Correct Active Voice: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Laughing at"** is a **phrasal verb **which means **to show amusement or ridicule towards someone or something.**
 
• **For example:**
 
 
• The students were **laughing at** the teacher's jokes.
 
• I felt embarrassed when I realized they were **laughing at** me.
